content:
rory.sales: Helios Health RFI inbound — they want ISO27001 evidence, HSM-backed KMS (customer-provided OK), dual-region residency (eu-west-1 + us-east-1), and a 45-day PoC that demonstrates 500 TPS on a 2B-parameter model. They asked for a capability matrix, PoC SOW, and a ballpark price for both POC and 12-month reserved. Can @devin.se and @priya.security weigh in? :clipboard:

devin.se: We can cover that via Redwood Dedicated or Private. Hosted API won't satisfy BYO-HSM. Need clarification: 500 TPS is inference requests/sec or token/sec? Also 2B model perf varies by topology & sequence length; send expected avg tokens per request.

priya.security: For HSM we support KMIP & customer-managed HSMs in Private. We'll need vendor certs (FIPS 140-2/3), HSM attestation, and an owner-signed IKL. For ISO evidence we can provide our ISO27k summary + most recent ISO audit statement. If they require FedRAMP-style control mappings, request a control-by-control scoping doc from them.

lee.finance: Pricing note: Typical POC structure: 2-week prep (network + HSM onboarding), 45-day run. We can offer a reduced rate for POC if they commit to a 12-month reserved at PoC completion. Ballpark: POC infra seats + HSM ops ~ $45k-$75k depending on GPU type and throughput. Reserved annual pricing will be lower per-token; I can produce a model once we have tokens/day.

marta.legal: We'll need to ship a DPA + BYO-HSM addendum. Also confirm whether Helios requires subprocessors list and cert retention. I'll prepare a template and mark the clauses they usually push on (data residency, audit rights, breach notification SLA).

devin.se: Draft capability matrix snippet (first pass):

"Capability | Hosted | Dedicated | Private (VPC / Customer HSM)
---|---|---|---
ISO27001 | Yes (org-level) | Yes | Yes (customer controls)
BYO-HSM | No | Limited (vendor-managed options) | Yes (KMIP, cert exchange)
Data residency | Region routing | Region pinning | Full control: customer-owned subnets
Throughput SLAs | Best-effort | Configurable | Contracted per SOW
PoC complexity | Low | Medium | High
"

ci-bot: Files added by devin.se: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/Helios-RFI (helios-capability-matrix-v1.xlsx, poc-sow-outline.md) :paperclip:

rory.sales: I'll ask Helios to confirm: (1) 500 TPS definition (req/sec vs token/sec), (2) avg tokens per request, (3) HSM vendor + certificate bundle, (4) subprocessors ok? If they agree to a follow-on reserved commit we can be flexible on POC pricing. Action list: devin finalize matrix v2 by tomorrow, priya prepare HSM checklist, lee run a rough pricing model with gpu assumptions, marta ready the DPA addendum template.

priya.security: On it 1: HSM checklist (short): vendor name, FIPS certs, KMIP endpoint + client cert, attestation letter, operator contact.

devin.se: Will have v2 by 09:00 PT tomorrow.

lee.finance: I'll sketch pricing scenarios and attach by EOD.

rory.sales: Great — I'll update Helios after matrix v2. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
